blockr.assistant: An LLM Assistant Extension for 'blockr'

blockr.assistant-package.Rd

Building on the docking layout manager provided by 'blockr.dock', this extension hosts an 'ellmer'-powered chat interface alongside a 'blockr' board. The chat is equipped with tools that allow a large language model to inspect and manipulate board state – adding, removing and modifying blocks, links and stacks – via the same update channel used by interactive user actions.
